A glimpse of Economy Lecture 1 with Vivek Sir in the PMP 2027 at LevelUp IAS. After the program introduction by Santosh Sir, the session moved straight into the first Economy class. This marks the beginning of classroom learning under the Prelims Master Program 2027, as aspirants start their focused preparation for UPSC Prelims from here.

Enrollment Open in PMP 2027: https://shorturl.at/YvX9J

Call at 8826496658

Meet us - 📍Location: LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre; Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/NvPyzytSwDQYEu8PA
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh
